full_judgment: 3. Petitioner filed the aforesaid case under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act claiming that he is a co-sharer by purchase and vendor opposite party No.4 of the pre-emption case in collusion with stranger purchaser opposite party nos.1-3 sold .28 acres of land to those purchaser behind the back and knowledge of the petitioner on 07.04.1977 and kept the same concealed from the petitioner by not delivering possession of the case land to those stranger purchasers and the petitioner came to know about the sale on 05.03.1979 and after search to obtained certified copy of the sale deed on 09.03.1979 and was confirmed about the sale. He being co- sharer was entitled to get pre-emption of the case land and filed the case on 14.03.1979 by depositing price money with compensation. The case was contested by strager purchaser opposite party Nos.1-3 denying material allegations and asserting that they were in possession of the case land from date of their purchase and further asserted that vendor opposite party No.4 of the pre-emption case died during pendency of the case and his heirs having not been substituted the case was barred by limitation and bad for defect of party.
